name: Fun Jump - FULL GAME (Version 10.0)
author: LizzardDev
description: The entire game is now out! This includes all levels 0-40. With areas such as the fields, the city, the beach, and the moon. If you win, give me an idea for something to add to the sequel game! I hope you enjoy this 2D Platformer with a couple of twists. This took more than 7 months to make, so any feedback would be appreciated. This game will also have a few updates before the sequel gets worked on. Have fun!
